'''Soras Varn''' was the individual responsible for writing ''[[Bounty Hunter Means and Methods: Comparative Psychological Perspectives and Quantifications]]''. It was first published in the proceedings of the [[Institute of Imperial Psychological Studies]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soras Varn was first mentioned ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''<ref name="GG10" /> and was later referenced in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
